title: Latham & Watkins Expands M&A and Private Equity Practices in New York
主要内容: Latham & Watkins LLP announced on January 31, 2022, that Caroline Blitzer Phillips has joined as a partner in the Mergers & Acquisitions and Private Equity Practices, and as a member of the Corporate Department. Phillips represents private equity firms and public and private companies in mergers, acquisitions, investments, and joint ventures. The firm expects continued heavy deal flow in 2022, with a strong focus on the energy and infrastructure sector. Phillips has experience in the energy transition, power, and infrastructure industries. Paul Sheridan, Global Chair of Latham's Private Equity Practice, noted that Caroline's experience aligns with the firm's transactional platform.
